It is a highly sought-after and innovative overdrive circuit. The BYOC Silver Pony version uses true bypass, meaning it does not have a buffered bypass. The enclosure is painted or screen printed and comes with a red LED and brown 1400 style knobs. It’s worth noting that as of June 15, 2020, version 2.1 of the Silver Pony has been released. This updated version no longer includes toggle switches for multiple clipping or bass response options. Summary created by AI from the original source.
